advisory.name: render_harness_identity
advisory.error: Carried forward from Phase 3.1: no render-harness target exists in plugins/O-MicrotonalSampler/tests/. Phase 3.4 introduces zero new audio code paths in processBlock or voices — the loop-override path is a pure message-thread SampleMap mutation that voices read via the existing snapshot mechanism (Stage 2 EC-3 invariant). Coverage substituted by pluginval --strictness 5 + auval (both green).

phaseGateCriteria.criterion: Click loaded cell → editor opens with waveform render in <250 ms; markers visible at correct loopStart/loopEnd
phaseGateCriteria.note: getWaveformPeaks is O(N) on slot audio (≈1 ms / 5 s sample at 48 kHz). openLoopEditor awaits JSON, populates header, shows panel, defers redrawLoopEditor one frame so transition settles. Marker positions read from snap.loopStart / snap.loopEnd. Manual DAW timing verification deferred to user.

phaseGateCriteria.criterion: Drag start marker rightward, Apply → next note-on plays from new loop region (audible difference)
phaseGateCriteria.note: overrideLoopPoints deep-copies the SampleMap, mutates target slot's loop fields, atomic-stores, fires callback. Voice startNote snapshots the new map; the audible region change applies on the next note-on per Stage 2 EC-3. Toast 'New loop points apply to next note-on.' surfaces the deferred behavior. Manual DAW listening test deferred to user.

phaseGateCriteria.criterion: Reset → markers snap back to LoopDetector's auto-detected values; mode reverts to "auto"
phaseGateCriteria.note: resetLoopToAutoDetect re-runs LoopDetector::detectLoop on slot->audio. Valid region → LoopMode::Auto + new loop fields. Invalid → LoopMode::OneShot + zeros. JS Reset handler then re-fetches peaks (getWaveformPeaks) carrying the fresh loopStart/loopEnd/loopMode from the new SampleMap; populateLoopEditorHeader + redrawLoopEditor reflect the change.

updateResetButtonState checks isOneShot(snap) against 'one-shot' / 'oneshot' (case-insensitive); disables Reset button (opacity 0.45 + cursor not-allowed) + sets title 'Sample is one-shot — no loop region detected.' (EC3-7).

phaseGateCriteria.criterion: Editor open during active note → marker move + Apply does NOT cut current voice; new loop applies on next note-on (EC3-6)
phaseGateCriteria.note: Voices snapshot std::shared_ptr<SampleMap> at startNote and hold for the note's duration (Stage 2 EC-3 invariant). overrideLoopPoints allocates a new SampleMap via std::make_shared<SampleMap>(*current); the old map remains alive transitively for held voices. Apply toast surfaces deferred-application behavior. Manual DAW verification (sustain a note, drag markers, click Apply, observe no cut + next note-on plays new region) deferred to user.

phaseGateCriteria.criterion: Canvas crisp on Retina (DPR test); stretches correctly at min/max window sizes
phaseGateCriteria.note: redrawLoopEditor reads window.devicePixelRatio, sets canvas.width = clientWidth * dpr + canvas.height = clientHeight * dpr, then ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0) so subsequent drawing uses CSS pixels (memory pitfall #6 — O-TextureForge precedent). ResizeObserver on canvas re-renders on dimension change so window-resize stretching is correct. Canvas sized via CSS width: calc(100% - 0px) + height: 200px (NEVER position: absolute with left+right per memory pitfall #6 — canvas is a CSS replaced element).

handleCellSingleClick for cell-loaded class now calls openLoopEditor(midi, layer) directly — replaces the Phase 3.2 console.log placeholder. Context menu open-loop-editor action also routes to openLoopEditor.
